full_page.content:
1935, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 73 Cont.
Marie Roze - 15 - fits - nerveous, worries.
Dec. 4th
Mrs. Mary Sytek - 41 - of Metz, Mich. - Sent home Oct. 29 from Ann Arbor Hospital as hopeless - cancer of womb, Enrolled 2 weeks ago. The fearful pains stopped next day .... Enrolled To-day (5.00) per- petually - all promising frequent Com.
Page 74
John Lauhoff - 53 - T.B. - Examination To-morrow
Dec. 5
Mrs. Mary Cahill -32- Cancer of stomach - has had two operations in 18 months . .. .
Mrs. Anna Harkins - in Ann Arbor Hospital invalid promised about last May to do something special for the Poor Souls if helped. So far there seems very little improvement, if any. She keeps her promise nevertheless every month .....
Mrs. Anna Keulehan - 75 - diabetis .....
Walter Daly - 16 - sarcomic cancer fears another operation.
Loretta Urban - 5 - almost blind - doctoring 4 yrs. without results, child fearful & nerveous. Was enrolled in Seraph. 100% improved. Deo Gr.
Page 75 Dec. 5 Cyril Van Walleghem - 48 - drinks terribly and always quarreling & cursing except when sober which is very seldom. Has wife and three - oldest 15. Has not been to sacraments since in America 16 yrs. ago. Not known if he ever made his confession or communion. Wife started perpetual enrollment of him last month at $1.00 per week ... To-day ( 1.00) and promises to read the "City of God" - Life of Mary Immaculate if husband goes to sacraments at least X mas.
Mary Salamacha - 18 - paral. since March last (St. Joseph Hosp) now bed-ridden.
Sister Edw'd Marie ..... Uncle E. Karber promises 100 Enrollments for Poor Souls if St.
Mrs. Jennie Hesier & Son Geo. bronchitis ...
